WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, login_state, member_key AS order_member_key,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.member_key, w.login_state, w.order_member_key, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) n_lines, SUM(net_amount) web_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN member_key IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) member_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN login_state='logged_in' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) loggedin_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN login_state='logged_in' AND member_key IS NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) loggedin_nokey,
  SUM(CASE WHEN login_state='guest' AND member_key IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) guest_withkey,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (member_key IS NULL) <> (order_member_key IS NULL) THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) mismatch
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
SELECT fiscal_period, min(period_start_date) s, max(period_end_date) e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 8 AND 12 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)) wk, login_state, status, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_member
FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-13' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-30'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT date_trunc('week', CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)) wk, count(*) n_logged_in, sum(CASE WHEN member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_member,
 min(CASE WHEN member_key IS NULL THEN order_ts_utc END) first_null
FROM fact_web_order WHERE login_state='logged_in' AND order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-29' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount,
           COALESCE(f.member_key, w.order_member_key) AS member_key_fixed
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.member_key_fixed IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2
